manual_review_policy: Manual Review contains extraction/data exceptions only; valid unmatched listings remain in Tracker with a screening label. Both Google Sheets tabs are upserted from the corresponding GitHub JSON/CSV records.
tracker_policy: All valid portal listings are upserted to Florida Tracker; keyword matches are labeled and unmatched listings are explicitly marked for manual screening. Existing rows and user-owned columns are preserved.
date_time_policy: Published/open and closing date-time values are copied from official API fields when available. Source timestamps are preserved; missing times/time zones are left blank rather than guessed.
